mapper.select: SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.wbs.selectWbs */ t.TASK_ID as taskId, t.TASK_NAME as taskName, t.TASK_DES as taskDes, t.TASK_STATUS as taskStatus, t.IS_TEST as isTest, t.TASK_DEPTH as taskDepth, t.STG_ID as stgId, t.PT_TASK_ID as ptTaskId, pt.TASK_NAME as ptTaskName, t.TASK_SEQ as taskSeq, t.TASK_ST as taskSt, t.TASK_ET as taskEt, t.TASK_RST as taskRst, t.TASK_RET as taskRet, t.TASK_ASI as taskAsi, t.TASK_RATE as taskRate, t.PJT_ID as pjtId, t.user_id as userId FROM TASK t LEFT JOIN TASK pt ON t.PT_TASK_ID = pt.TASK_ID WHERE t.TASK_ID = #{taskId}

/* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.wbs.selectListWbsSearch */ WITH RECURSIVE search_matches AS ( SELECT task_id, task_name, task_des, task_status, is_test, task_depth, stg_id, pt_task_id, task_seq, task_st, task_et, task_rst, task_ret, task_asi, task_rate, pjt_id, user_id FROM task WHERE pjt_id = #{pjtId}
AND task_id like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskId}, '%')
AND task_name like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskName}, '%')
AND task_status like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskStatus}, '%')
AND stg_id like CONCAT('%', #{scStgId}, '%')
AND task_asi like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskAsi}, '%')
AND task_rate like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskRate}, '%')
),
parent_tasks AS ( SELECT task_id, task_name, task_des, task_status, is_test, task_depth, stg_id, pt_task_id, task_seq, task_st, task_et, task_rst, task_ret, task_asi, task_rate, pjt_id, user_id FROM search_matches
UNION ALL
SELECT t.task_id, t.task_name, t.task_des, t.task_status, t.is_test, t.task_depth, t.stg_id, t.pt_task_id, t.task_seq, t.task_st, t.task_et, t.task_rst, t.task_ret, t.task_asi, t.task_rate, t.pjt_id, t.user_id FROM task t INNER JOIN parent_tasks pt ON t.task_id = pt.pt_task_id WHERE t.pjt_id = #{pjtId} ),
child_tasks AS ( SELECT task_id, task_name, task_des, task_status, is_test, task_depth, stg_id, pt_task_id, task_seq, task_st, task_et, task_rst, task_ret, task_asi, task_rate, pjt_id, user_id FROM search_matches
UNION ALL
SELECT t.task_id, t.task_name, t.task_des, t.task_status, t.is_test, t.task_depth, t.stg_id, t.pt_task_id, t.task_seq, t.task_st, t.task_et, t.task_rst, t.task_ret, t.task_asi, t.task_rate, t.pjt_id, t.user_id FROM task t INNER JOIN child_tasks ct ON t.pt_task_id = ct.task_id WHERE t.pjt_id = #{pjtId} ),
all_related_tasks AS ( SELECT DISTINCT * FROM parent_tasks UNION SELECT DISTINCT * FROM child_tasks ),
task_hierarchy AS ( SELECT t.task_id, t.task_name, t.task_des, t.task_status, t.is_test, t.task_depth, t.stg_id, t.pt_task_id, t.task_seq, t.task_st, t.task_et, t.task_rst, t.task_ret, t.task_asi, t.task_rate, t.pjt_id, pt.task_name as pt_task_name, t.user_id, CAST(LPAD(t.task_id, 10, '0') AS CHAR(1000)) AS sort_path FROM all_related_tasks t LEFT JOIN task pt ON t.pt_task_id = pt.task_id WHERE t.pt_task_id = 0 OR t.pt_task_id NOT IN (SELECT task_id FROM all_related_tasks)
UNION ALL
SELECT t.task_id, t.task_name, t.task_des, t.task_status, t.is_test, t.task_depth, t.stg_id, t.pt_task_id, t.task_seq, t.task_st, t.task_et, t.task_rst, t.task_ret, t.task_asi, t.task_rate, t.pjt_id, pt.task_name as pt_task_name, t.user_id, CONCAT(th.sort_path, '-', LPAD(t.task_id, 10, '0')) AS sort_path FROM all_related_tasks t INNER JOIN task_hierarchy th ON t.pt_task_id = th.task_id LEFT JOIN task pt ON t.pt_task_id = pt.task_id ), ranked_tasks AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sort_path) as rn FROM task_hierarchy ) SELECT task_id as taskId, task_name as taskName, task_des as taskDes, task_status as taskStatus, is_test as isTest, task_depth as taskDepth, stg_id as stgId, pt_task_id as ptTaskId, pt_task_name as ptTaskName, task_seq as taskSeq, task_st as taskSt, task_et as taskEt, task_rst as taskRst, task_ret as taskRet, task_asi as taskAsi, task_rate as taskRate, pjt_id as pjtId, user_id as userId FROM ranked_tasks WHERE rn BETWEEN ((#{pageIndex} - 1) * #{pageSize} + 1) AND (#{pageIndex} * #{pageSize}) ORDER BY sort_path
